Rank 2 Melee Technique

  • Ki Cost: 15 Ki
  • Casting Time: When you take the Attack Action or cast a Melee/Melee Weapon Technique
  • Range: Self
  • Chargeable?: No
  • Duration: Until the start of your next turn

Push your strikes even FURTHER using Ki. For the duration of this technique you gain +1 Static Bonus to all Melee Attack Rolls and Melee/Melee Weapon Techniques.
